exposure: cornual wedge resection for interstitial pregnancy
outcome: rates of persistent or recurrent interstitial pregnancy
cohort: 29 patients with interstitial pregnancies treated with cornual wedge resection between 1992 and 2013 at one hospital
finding: Cornual wedge resection for interstitial pregnancies was associated with a 30% incidence of subsequent uterine rupture or dehiscence, no cases of persistent or recurrent interstitial pregnancy, and a 71.4% subsequent pregnancy rate in those trying to conceive.
